_comment_about_this_file: Reference for connecting one MCP client to multiple platform bridges at once. Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). winpc-gui (v0.2) and macbox-gui (v0.3) are real; entries prefixed with _planned are roadmap placeholders and won't be loaded by Claude Code (the prefix is illegal in MCP server names).

_legend.winpc: Windows 11 test host (v0.1.0; v0.2.0 consolidated winpc-shell tools into winpc-gui)
_legend.macbox: macOS desktop (v0.3.0; macbox-gui MCP on port 8767)
_legend.iphone: iOS device (v0.5.0 planned; host on macOS)

_planned_android._note: Android driver runs on the agent host directly; stdio is simpler than SSE for same-machine.
